book.name: Mako
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Mako

content: Yesu ajingi ku Yelusalemu kwa chiheku
Yesu na bhabhulwa bhaki pabhakaheghali muchi wa Yelusalemu, upambala cha Besifage na Besania, pambipi na Chitombi cha Mizeituni. Yesu akabhatumiki bhabhulwa bhaki bhabhele,
akabhapwaghile, “Njendanya ku chijiji chechibhi palongi jinu. Pamwibya njingi monihomu, anamulihimanya liponda likongakiki, liponda heli ngachejendi mundu. Mkabhopula na mkaletaje.
Ngati mundu anandalukile, ‘Ndandi kiki mulibhopo liponda heli? Mumpwaghila, Bambo alipala na anakelebhua kabheti pambani esajeno.’ ”
Bhela bhakapiti na bhakalihimani liponda lela likongakiki pundyangu wa nyumba punkeghi ja indela. Pabhakabhi bhabhopola,
bhandu bhabhakabhi panipala bhakabhalalukile, “Ndandi kiki mbopo liponda heli?”
Bhabhulwa bhakayangiki ngati moakapwaghi Yesu, na bhandu bhala bhakajetaki bhajenda nalo.
Bhakumpelaki Yesu liponda lela, na kutandika ingobhu yabhu panani ja liponda, na Yesu akatami panani jaki.
Bhandu bhamahele bhakatandiki ingobhu yabhu mwindela, na bhangi bhakajaliki matutu ghabhaghahekiti mumighonda.
Bhandu bhokapi bhabhalongulili na bhabhajengalyaji bhakatumbwi kujamalila, “Chapanga Alumbalikaje! Apengalika jonihoju joahika kwa lihina laka Bambo!
Upengalika ukolongwa ghouhika waka hokolu witu Daude! Ulumbalilu kwaka Chapanga kunani kumahunde!”

Yesu akahiki ku Yelusalemu na kujenda palubhanja lwa Nyumba jaka Chapanga, akalingali kila chindu wichu. Nambu ndandi kukabhi pakamihi, akapiti ku Besania papamu na bhabhulwa bhaki komi na bhabhele bhala.
Yesu aupeke masolu nkongu wa mtini
Chilabhu jaki, pabhakabhi bhakelabhuka kuhuma ku Besania, Yesu akabhi na injala.

Bhela akauweni cha kutali nkongu wa mtini ukabya na mahamba ghamahele. Akauheghali nahuli kulinga ngati aweza kughabhona mapambiku. Nambu paakauheghalili, ngacheaghaweni mapambiku nambu mahamba matopo, ndandi ngachechabhi chikahi cha kupambika mapambiku.
Yesu akaupwaghi nkongu wa mtini ghola, “Kutumbu lalenu mbaka mileli nga mundu joanakulaje mapambiku ghaku kabheti!” Na bhabhulwa bhaki bhakajowini malobhi ghanihagha.
Yesu ajingi mu Nyumba jaka Chapanga

Bhela pabhahiki ku Yelusalemu, Yesu akapiti ku Nyumba jaka Chapanga na kutumbu kubhatopo bhandu bhabhakabhi bhalombesa na kulomba hindu. Akang'anambwi meza ya bhabhabhi bhang'anambulana mbija na hitehu ya bhabhabhi bhalombesa ngunda,
na ngacheandekiki mundu jokapi kupeta na chindu chokapi chela palubhanja lwa Nyumba jaka Chapanga.
Bhela akabhabholiki bhandu, “Bho, ngacheyalembakiki mu Malembu Mahuhu, ‘Nyumba jangu anajibya Nyumba ja malobhu kwa mataifa ghokapi?’ Nambu mabhanganya mjitehi kubha likolu la bhihe!”

Bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa na bhabhola bha Shelia pabhakajowini malobhi ghanihagha, bhakatumbwi kulonda indela ja kunkoma Yesu. Nambu bhakunjowipi, ndandi lipogha lokapi la bhandu lakakangichi mabholu ghaki.
Chimihi pachahikaje, Yesu na bhabhulwa bhaki bhakabhokiki pamuchi ghonighola.
Mabholu gha nkongu wa mtini ghoujomike
Chilabhu jaki palukela, pabhapetika mwindela, bhakauweni nkongu wa mtini ghola ujomiki kaghajo wokapi kutumbu kumikegha mbaka kunani.
Petulu akakombwiki chechatendakiki na akumpwaghi Yesu, “Mbola, lingalyaje! Nkongu wa mtini ghoupeki masolu ghola ujomike!”
Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Munhobhalya Chapanga.

Numpwaghi chakaka, mundu anaachipwaghi chitombi chenje, ‘Jighukaje na ukalilekala mubahali,’ panga kubhona choghohi muntima waki, nambu anahobhale malobhi ghokapi ghalonge anaghahengakikaje, chakaka analihengakika kwake.
Bhela numpwaghila, pansalila na kulobha chindu, muhobhalya kubha njopalile, nanamu anampataje.
Panjema na kundobha Chapanga, mundekakya kila mundu joanhoki chokapi, nahuli Atati winu joabhi kunani kumahunde andekakya na mwenga mahoku ghinu.
Nambu nangakubhalekake bhajinu, hata Atati winu joabhi kunani kumahunde ngaandekakeli mwanganya mahoku ghinu.”
Malalukilu kubhokana na lujiniku lwaka Yesu
Bhela bhakahiki kabheti ku Yelusalemu. Yesu paakabhi ajenda pa liwangala la Nyumba jaka Chapanga, bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa, bhabhola bha Shelia na bhazee bhakunjendili,
na bhakundalukile, “Bho, uhenga mambu ghangane kwa lujiniku lwaka nane? Bho, nde nane joakupeki wehapa lujiniku lwa kuhenga mambu ghangane?”
Nambu Yesu akabhayangike, “Ananundalukya lilaluki limu. Anamniyangiki, nanatu ananumpwaghila kubha nhenga mambu ghangani kwa lujiniku lwaka nane.
Mbwaghilaje, bho, lujiniku lwaka Yohana Mbatizaji lukahumiki kunani kwaka Chapanga au kwa bhandu? Mniyangaje.”
Bhakatumbwi kulongalanela, “Anatupwaghiki, ‘Ghakahumiki kwaka Chapanga,’ anaatulalukya, ‘Bho, mbona ngachemunhobhali Yohana?’
Kabheti anatupwaghiki, ‘Ghakahumiki kwa bhandu,’ kwibya bhole?” Bhakajowipi lipogha la bhandu, maghambu bhandu bhokapi bhakahobhali kubha Yohana akabhi chakaka mlota waka Chapanga.
Bhela bhakamuyangiki Yesu, “Tepani ngachetumanye.” Na jombi Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Na nepani nganumpwaghi nhenga mambu ghangani kwa lujiniku bhole.”
